{{Quote|Before the Empire invaded Balmorra, we sabotaged the facility, turning the droids into crazed killing machines.|[[Lieutenant Major]] [[Pirrell]]|<ref name="TOR:CatDF">{{TORcite|type=class|Bounty Hunter|Chaos at the Droid Factory|Balmorra}}</ref>}}
The '''Okara Droid Factory''' was a droid facility located on the [[Markaran Plains]] on [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorra]]. During the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Imperial]] [[Battle of Balmorra (Galactic Wars)|invasion]] of Balmorra, they introduced a virus to the factory [[Droid/Legends|droids]], turning them hostile against the workers. However, the virus worked too well and even years later the droids kept patrolling the factory, blasting any organics venturing close to it.
